caption: The drawing shows a single wine glass centrally positioned on a plain background. The wine glass is depicted with clear, precise lines and shaded areas indicating transparency and reflection. The bowl of the glass is rounded and features a pattern of vertical grooves or flutes around its exterior. The stem is slender and smooth, connecting the bowl to a broad, circular base that has shading to suggest its flatness and reflective surface. The entire drawing is rendered in grayscale pencil or graphite, with no additional colors, and is enclosed within a simple, thin rectangular border. The background is blank, highlighting the glass as the sole object in the composition.
title: Wine Glass
